%%%STDOUT%%%
usage: paceghost [-h]
                 {show,ghost,race,season,board,fieldday,ladder,rematch,meet,table,reign,days}
                 ...

Race a recorded run against the ghost of your best run.

positional arguments:
  {show,ghost,race,season,board,fieldday,ladder,rematch,meet,table,reign,days}
    show                print one recorded run
    ghost               print the standing ghost
    race                race a live run against a ghost
    season              print the season report for a
                        field of runs
    board               print the live board for a run
                        carrying timed reads
    fieldday            print the stolen record report for
                        a field day
    ladder              print the ladder report for a
                        field day and its windows
    rematch             print the rematch report for two
                        field days
    meet                print the meet report for three or
                        more field days
    table               print the meet table for three or
                        more field days
    reign               print the meet reign for three or
                        more field days
    days                print the meet days for three or
                        more field days

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
%%%STDERR%%%
